subject: The Designed Manufactured Installed promise
hook: Three suppliers, one wardrobe, and nobody owns the gap
ig:
Three suppliers, one wardrobe, and nobody owns the gap.

It's common to have one company design, another make and a third fit. It can work. But these are the gaps we see open up:

The measurement gap. If it doesn't fit, the maker blames the measurements and the measurer blames the maker.

The design-to-site gap. A layout that looks perfect on screen meets a sloping ceiling or a radiator on the day.

The finish mismatch. Fillers and end panels sourced separately are never quite the same colour as the doors.

The scheduling gap. You wait on someone else's diary.

The callback gap. Six months later, a door needs adjusting. Who do you call?

That's why we design, make and install everything ourselves, with one team from first sketch to final adjustment.

Save this before you get quotes, and use it as a checklist. Free design consultation via the link in bio.
fb:
If you've ever had furniture designed by one firm, made by another and fitted by a third, you might recognise this.

When something doesn't fit, everyone points at someone else. Fillers don't quite match the doors. Dates slip because one company is waiting on another. And when a door needs adjusting later, nobody's sure who to call.

That's the reason we do all three ourselves: designed with you, made in our Hanley workshop and installed by our own team. One point of contact, start to finish. Have a look at what we make here:
